story_candidates.title: An independent study of five coding agents: reverts, security and review waits

ai_path.connection: Direct: research on code written by AI coding agents.

story_candidates.angle: A research paper's abstract reports revert rates that differ by coding agent, fewer security smells in pooled agent code and uneven review waits, across 37,623 pull requests; the paper's figures, abstract only.
story_candidates.note: For journalist-ai, categories AI and Corporate. Ready. An arXiv paper's abstract page (submitted 12 September 2026): say it is a research paper read from its abstract only, that the full paper and its method were not read, and that the figures are the paper's own and were not checked. Read the abstract page yourself; give what it reports: 37,623 pull requests from five named coding agents and a matched human baseline across 2,807 repositories, December 2024 to July 2025; revert rates differ by vendor (the paper gives 6.1% against 11.5% for human pull requests for one agent, 14.5% for another); pooled agent code was less likely to contain a security smell; review effort is uneven (one agent's pull requests waited a median 12.6 hours for a first human review). Say plainly what it measures (reverts of pull requests, not production incidents) and that the period is earlier than the companies' posts; no ranking of vendors beyond the paper's wording and no verdict on AI code. Link the three published company accounts as a comparison (S80 CrewAI: crewai-trust-starts-with-human-review; S81 Intercom: intercom-ai-approves-code-changes; S82 Spotify: spotify-ai-change-outran-checks) and repeat none of their content. Explain 'pull request', 'revert' and 'security smell' in plain words at first use. 300 to 700 words.
